header.title: Badge
header.description: Small label to mark a status, a category or a count. It can stand alone, sit next to text, or overlay a button or avatar to show notifications or presence. `Tag` is the same component under another name, meant for filters and removable labels.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the result. With `isDot` the badge becomes a dot and stops showing the text, icon and × button.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: The text goes in `children`. With no other props, the badge is `primary`, `soft`, `md` and fully rounded.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` sets the color. `primary`, `secondary` and `tertiary` come from the brand palettes; `success`, `warning`, `error` and `info` use the status colors; `neutral` is for labels with no special meaning.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the treatment: `soft` (default) with a light background, `solid` with a filled background and `outline` with the page background and a colored border. In `solid`, `warning` and `tertiary` use dark text.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` adjusts height, padding and text size: `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It also changes the dot and icon size.

icon.title: With icon
icon.description: `icon` adds an icon before the text. It takes the badge's text color and is hidden from screen readers.

count.title: Count
count.description: With `count` and no `children`, the badge shows a number. Above `max` (99 by default) it shows as `99+`. With `0` nothing renders unless you pass `showZero`.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.description: If `children` is a React element and you pass `count`, `content` or `isDot`, the badge wraps the element and sits in a corner. The indicator isn't part of the button's name: pass `aria-label` to the Badge to give the number context.

liveCount.title: Changing count
liveCount.description: The count has `role="status"`, so screen readers announce changes. At `0` it hides on its own. `isInvisible` hides it without unmounting the inner element.

content.title: Custom content
content.description: `content` replaces the number with any content and wins over `count`. If it's a symbol, like `!`, pass `role="img"` and an `aria-label` that explains it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: `placement` picks the corner: `top-end` (default), `top-start`, `bottom-end` or `bottom-start`. `offset` (in pixels) moves the indicator toward the center, useful on round avatars where the corner falls outside the circle.

dot.title: Dot
dot.description: `isDot` shows a dot instead of text, to signal presence or news. The dot is hidden from screen readers: include the state in the element's name, like the button's `aria-label`.

statusList.title: Dot with text
statusList.description: A dot without `children` works as a color cue next to text. The text conveys the status; the dot only reinforces it.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: `isClosable` adds a × button that calls `onClose`. The badge doesn't hide itself: remove it from the list in `onClose`. The button is announced as "Remove" by default; pass a `closeAriaLabel` that includes the tag name.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` dims the badge, blocks the × button and adds `aria-disabled`.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: `Tag` is an alias of `Badge`. Use it for filters and removable labels so the code makes the intent clear.

header.title: Badge API
header.description: API reference for the Badge React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or its subpath. `Tag` is the same component. `formatBadgeCount` applies the same `max` rule as the badge, in case you need the text elsewhere.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <span> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, except content) and forwards them to the root element, as well as ref. In overlay mode the root is the gem-badge-anchor wrapper; role and aria-label go to the indicator. classNames adds classes to each part: root, indicator (overlay only), icon, label and close.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.count: A count has role="status" and, without aria-label, is named with the formatted number (e.g. "99+"). Changes are announced.
a11y.overlay: In overlay mode the indicator sits next to the element, not inside it, so it isn't part of its name. Pass aria-label to the Badge (e.g. "8 unread") or include the number in the button's name.
a11y.dot: The dot has role="presentation" and aria-hidden: it isn't announced. The state must be in a text or in the element's name.
a11y.content: With content the indicator has no role. If it's a symbol, pass role="img" and aria-label.
a11y.close: The × button is a <button> named "Remove" by default. Pass a translated closeAriaLabel that includes the tag name. The click doesn't propagate to the wrapper.
a11y.disabled: With isDisabled the badge has aria-disabled and the × button is disabled.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: The badge. Receives `className` and `classNames.root` when standalone. Sets the default variable values.
rules.soft: Light background. It's the default variant and adds no rules of its own.
rules.solid: `--gem-badge-solid` background, light text and transparent border. With `warning` and `tertiary` the text is dark.
rules.size: Height, padding, gap, text, icon and dot size.
rules.dot: Dot without text in the `--gem-badge-solid` color.
rules.disabled: Reduced opacity and no pointer events.
rules.overlay: Absolutely positioned overlay indicator. Receives no pointer events.
rules.outlineRing: `--gem-color-bg` ring around the overlay indicator, with `showOutline`.
rules.label: Text. Truncates with an ellipsis if it doesn't fit. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.close: × button. Takes the text color. Receives `classNames.close`.
rules.anchor: Wrapper of the element and the indicator in overlay mode. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The tone and size classes set these variables on the same element, so to change them use a selector like `.gem-badge.my-class` (see Style changes). In overlay mode, use `classNames.indicator`.

items.--gem-badge-gap: Gap between icon, text and × button.
items.--gem-badge-offset: Overlay indicator offset. Set inline from `offset`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Badge. `{tone}` is `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary` or `neutral`, and `{status}` is `success`, `warning`, `error` or `info`.

items.--gem-color-{tone}-800: `soft` and `outline` text for brand tones and `neutral`.
items.--gem-color-{status}-solid: `solid` background and dot for status tones.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<span>`. `Tag` takes the same props.

items.children: Badge text, or the element the indicator overlays.
items.content: Custom content for the badge or indicator. Wins over `count`.
items.offset: Offset of the overlay indicator toward the center, in pixels.
items.isDot: Shows a dot instead of text.
items.isInvisible: Hides the indicator without unmounting the inner element.
items.showOutline: Ring around the overlay indicator to separate it from the element.
items.isDisabled: Dims the badge and blocks the × button.
items.role: ARIA role. Defaults to `status` on counts and `presentation` on dots.
items.aria-label: Accessible name of the badge or indicator. On counts it replaces the number.
items.onClose: Runs when the × button is pressed.
